listing.name: King's Field / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port prepared with your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Complete setup with the project’s launcher; you manage this copy, its updates and your saved data.

steps.title: Download and unpack the setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder. On Linux, follow the kit’s requirements for CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler. Use Linux tools for the Linux build.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream guide for the version you downloaded. Use your own original in its supported image representation, keeping a CUE and every referenced track together when required, and supply your own BIOS whenever that guide requires it. Follow the selected version’s completed-player instructions if upstream setup cannot relaunch it. The retained v0.3.6 guide describes earlier executable-name/generated-target problems and a later candidate correction; those dated reports do not establish that every current package is fixed or broken. Do not choose a compiler or unrelated helper as the player.

steps.title: Build the game and add it to Portcove
steps.instruction: Open the project’s launcher and follow its build instructions. Keep the completed game with its required program and compiler files. In Portcove, select the completed program or supported launcher and its start folder. Save the details, then choose Play.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. Use the project’s tools for updates and back up your original files, saves and settings yourself.
